tagline: Markdown and quotes with deep links

slides.title: Quote with a link to the exact passage
slides.text: Alt+Q copies the quote and a link. Whoever opens it lands on that passage, highlighted.

slides.title: Whole articles as Markdown
slides.text: No selecting: menus, ads and cookie banners stay behind. .md downloads start with title, author, date and your tags.

slides.title: Markdown that keeps the structure
slides.text: Headings, lists, links, code with its language, tables, and formulas as LaTeX. Or clean text, or clean HTML.

slides.title: Every table, one click away
slides.text: Copy as CSV, TSV for Excel and Sheets, Markdown or JSON. Your last format is one click.

slides.title: Private by design
slides.text: No account, no server, no network requests. A page is read only when you ask. Light and dark.
